name: building-blocks-keycaps
title: Keycaps
description: Compact Tailwind keyboard-key atoms for documenting shortcuts and command hints.
useWhen: Compact Tailwind keyboard-key atoms for documenting shortcuts and command hints.
avoidWhen: Avoid keycaps when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Keycaps uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
